caption: The drawing features two separate horizontal decorative bands on a light beige background. Both bands are predominantly black with golden yellow motifs. The upper band is a rectangular strip containing a repeating floral design with various leaves and flowers in golden yellow, including a large five-petaled flower on the left and several grouped floral elements dispersed across the strip. The lower band has a similar rectangular shape but with rounded ends. Its design includes two woven basket-like shapes holding lobed flowers and leaves, also in golden yellow, with additional leafy branches extending outward to the left and right. Both bands are evenly spaced, parallel, and centered on the page.
title: Hitchcock Chair
